name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park — 1 Block from Knott's!) Famous Cheese Roll (Quesito), Chicken Croquette & Potato Ball
brandOrRestaurant: Porto's Bakery & Cafe (Beach Blvd, Buena Park · Steps from Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Located literally one block north of Knott's Berry Farm on Beach Blvd, Porto's Bakery is a Southern California legend: their flaky puff-pastry **Cheese Roll**, creamy **Chicken Croquette**, and whipped mashed-potato **Potato Ball (Papa Rellena)** have ultra-smooth textures and cost ~$1.50–$2.25 each!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order ahead or grab a box of Cheese Rolls, Dulce de Leche Besitos, Chicken Croquettes, and plain Potato Balls (avoid the Spicy Pepper/Cheese Potato Ball!) before or after Knott's, and take a lactase enzyme.
watchOuts: Order the classic Beef Potato Ball or Chicken Croquette—skip the Jalapeño/Spicy Potato Ball and Guava Roll (if avoiding guava seeds, though Porto's guava paste is strained smooth!)
